title: Implement fixed 17-operation system with locked operation list

requirements.text: Create a stable Operations data structure in backend/main.mo with fields: operation_id (Nat, primary key) and operation_name (Text), pre-populated with exactly 17 fixed operations in sequential order: 1=Boxing, 2=Welding/Finishing, 3=Rear Wall, 4=Front Wall, 5=Side Wall, 6=Roof, 7=Rear Door, 8=Blasting & Primer, 9=Final Paint, 10=Gasket, 11=DLM, 12=Plywood, 13=Floor Screw, 14=Decal, 15=Data Plate, 16=Sikha, 17=Black Paint

quotes: Predefine and lock the following 17 operations as fixed rows: 1 Boxing 2 Welding/Finishing 3 Rear Wall 4 Front Wall 5 Side Wall 6 Roof 7 Rear Door 8 Blasting & Primer 9 Final Paint 10 Gasket 11 DLM 12 Plywood 13 Floor Screw 14 Decal 15 Data Plate 16 Sikha 17 Black Paint

acceptanceCriteria: Operations data structure exists in backend stable variables
Exactly 17 operations are pre-populated with sequential IDs 1-17
Operation names match the exact list provided by user
Data persists across canister upgrades

requirements.text: Create a backend query function getAllOperations in backend/main.mo that returns all 17 Operations records with their operation_id and operation_name values in sequential order (1-17)
acceptanceCriteria: Function returns all 17 operations in order
Each operation includes operation_id and operation_name
Function is callable by both admin and viewer roles

requirements.text: Remove all backend functions that allow adding, deleting, or modifying operation entries (if any exist), ensuring operations remain permanently locked to the predefined 17

quotes: Admin cannot add or delete operations

acceptanceCriteria: No backend function exists to create new operations
No backend function exists to delete operations
No backend function exists to modify operation names or IDs
Only the 17 predefined operations are accessible

requirements.text: Update the createDailyProductionReport backend function in backend/main.mo to validate that the operation_id parameter is between 1-17 inclusive, returning an error if the operation_id is out of range or does not match an existing operation

quotes: Admin can only update numeric production values

acceptanceCriteria: Function accepts operation_id (Nat) parameter
Function validates operation_id is between 1-17
Function returns error for invalid operation_id
Function creates production record only for valid operation_id

requirements.text: Update the updateDailyProductionReport backend function in backend/main.mo to prevent any changes to the operation_id field, rejecting update attempts that try to change the operation assignment with an appropriate error message

quotes: Admin can only update numeric production values

acceptanceCriteria: Function does not allow operation_id field updates
Function returns error if operation_id change is attempted
Function allows updates to today_production, despatch, and date fields only

requirements.text: Update the ContainerDailyReportEntryPage component at frontend/src/pages/ContainerDailyReportEntryPage.tsx to always display all 17 predefined operations in exact sequential order (1-17) in the production entry table, fetching operation data from the getAllOperations backend function
acceptanceCriteria: Table displays exactly 17 rows in sequential order
Each row shows the correct operation_id (1-17) and operation_name

Operations are displayed in the exact order: Boxing, Welding/Finishing, Rear Wall, Front Wall, Side Wall, Roof, Rear Door, Blasting & Primer, Final Paint, Gasket, DLM, Plywood, Floor Screw, Decal, Data Plate, Sikha, Black Paint
All 17 rows are visible even if no production data exists for some operations

requirements.text: Update the ContainerDailyReportPage component at frontend/src/pages/ContainerDailyReportPage.tsx to always display all 17 predefined operations in exact sequential order (1-17) in the daily report view, showing zero or empty values for operations with no production data for the selected date
acceptanceCriteria: Report table displays exactly 17 rows in sequential order
All operations from 1-17 are visible regardless of data availability
Operations without data show zero or empty values
Operations are displayed in the predefined order

requirements.text: Update all production dashboard and history components (ProductionDashboardPage, ProductionHistoryPage, DailyProductionReportTable) to display operations in the predefined sequential order (1-17) when showing production data, using operation_id for sorting and operation_name for display
acceptanceCriteria: All components display operations in sequential order 1-17
Operation names are fetched from the Operations table via backend
No custom operation names or out-of-order operations appear
Sorting by operation maintains the 1-17 sequence

requirements.text: Ensure the useGetAllOperations React Query hook at frontend/src/hooks/useGetAllOperations.ts correctly fetches all 17 operations from the backend, with proper error handling and loading states, and returns operations in sequential order by operation_id
acceptanceCriteria: Hook fetches data from getAllOperations backend function
Hook returns exactly 17 operations in sequential order
Hook handles loading state properly
Hook handles error state properly
Operations data is cached appropriately

requirements.text: Add comprehensive validation in the ContainerDailyReportEntryPage save functionality to ensure all production records being saved reference valid operation_ids (1-17), displaying user-friendly error messages if validation fails

quotes: Admin can only update numeric production values

acceptanceCriteria: Save function validates all operation_ids are between 1-17
Save function shows error toast for invalid operation_ids
Save function prevents submission of invalid data
User receives clear feedback on validation errors

constraints: Operations list must remain exactly 17 entries with IDs 1-17
No user interface or backend function shall allow adding new operations
No user interface or backend function shall allow deleting existing operations
No user interface or backend function shall allow changing operation names or operation_id values
Backend Operations data structure must be stored in stable variables for persistence
All production records must reference operation_id (Nat) between 1-17
Frontend must always display operations in sequential order 1-17
nonGoals: Allowing dynamic addition or removal of operations
Changing the number of operations from 17
Modifying operation names after initial setup
